overview_description.description: Spring (formerly Teespring) provides creators with an end-to-end solution to build a successful commerce business, as well as building their brand. Creators can design and sell digital and physical products on Spring. They can utilize the platform’s powerful integrations with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch, Discord and Streamlabs allowing them to sell on social. Spring also handles order production, shipping, and customer service so users can focus on growing their brand.

about_short_description.short_description: Spring is the link between creators and commerce. Innovative tools and services empower creators to launch products while selling on social.

product.name: Teespring Social Commerce Platform
product.description: A platform enabling users to create, customize, and sell consumer goods like apparel and accessories through online campaigns.

product.name: Spring for Creators
product.description: A platform that enables creators to design, launch, and sell physical and digital products through custom online stores connected to their social channels.

product.name: Twitch Merch Store Integration
product.description: An integration that allows creators to sell merchandise directly on their Twitch channel with in-stream product browsing and checkout.

product.name: On-Demand Printed Apparel and Accessories
product.description: Customizable apparel and accessories printed on demand and shipped to customers after order placement.

product.name: Adobe Express Integration
product.description: A design tool integration offering templates and AI-powered features to help creators design products without leaving the Spring platform.

product.name: Product Fulfillment and Shipping Services
product.description: End-to-end production, fulfillment, shipping, and customer support services for creators selling physical and digital products.
